adjuster_notes_history.author: R. Iyer
adjuster_notes_history.note: Initial review opened. Requesting workshop diagnostic report for engine seizure.

adjuster_notes_history.author: R. Iyer
adjuster_notes_history.note: No Engine & Gearbox Protection endorsement (IMT-29) found on policy. Flagged for likely denial.

adjuster_notes_history.author: System
adjuster_notes_history.note: Claim denied - water ingress exclusion applies, no endorsement on file.

adjuster_notes_history.author: M. Fernandes
adjuster_notes_history.note: Parking lot collision, own damage only. Photos on file confirm bumper and taillight damage.

adjuster_notes_history.author: M. Fernandes
adjuster_notes_history.note: Straightforward own-damage repair, no third party involved. Approved for standard payout.

adjuster_notes_history.author: System
adjuster_notes_history.note: Settled: R17,000 (claimed R18,000 less R1,000 compulsory excess).

adjuster_notes_history.author: S. Rao
adjuster_notes_history.note: Structural cracking reported after earthquake. Site inspection scheduled.

adjuster_notes_history.author: S. Rao
adjuster_notes_history.note: No Earthquake Extension endorsement on file for this policy.

adjuster_notes_history.author: System
adjuster_notes_history.note: Claim denied - earthquake peril not covered without endorsement.

adjuster_notes_history.author: T. Naidoo
adjuster_notes_history.note: Kitchen fire, building structure damaged. No neighbouring or tenant property involved.

adjuster_notes_history.author: System
adjuster_notes_history.note: Settled: R80,000 (claimed R90,000 less R10,000 standard excess).

adjuster_notes_history.author: A. Khan
adjuster_notes_history.note: Pothole incident, front-left tyre and bumper damaged in same event. Insured holds IMT-28 Zero Dep cover.

adjuster_notes_history.author: A. Khan
adjuster_notes_history.note: Tyre depreciation exception applies under IMT-28 - 50% depreciation on tyre only, bumper covered in full.

adjuster_notes_history.author: System
adjuster_notes_history.note: Settled: R5,500 after depreciation and compulsory excess.

adjuster_notes_history.author: P. Singh
adjuster_notes_history.note: Overnight burglary reported. Electronics stolen from living room.

adjuster_notes_history.author: P. Singh
adjuster_notes_history.note: Back door found unlocked, no signs of forced or violent entry. Burglary section requires forcible and violent entry.

adjuster_notes_history.author: System
adjuster_notes_history.note: Claim denied - entry condition not met under Section 3.3 (Burglary & Theft).

adjuster_notes_history.author: R. Iyer
adjuster_notes_history.note: Windshield cracked by stone chip on highway. Insured holds glass breakage cover, no other damage claimed.

adjuster_notes_history.author: System
adjuster_notes_history.note: Settled: R4,500 in full, compulsory deductible waived for glass-only claim.

adjuster_notes_history.author: M. Fernandes
adjuster_notes_history.note: Vehicle reported stolen from parking lot 95 days ago. Awaiting police Non-Traceable Certificate.

adjuster_notes_history.author: M. Fernandes
adjuster_notes_history.note: Certificate still outstanding. Claim held pending, follow up with insured in 30 days.

adjuster_notes_history.author: S. Rao
adjuster_notes_history.note: Collision with median late at night. Breathalyzer report on file confirms driver was over the legal alcohol limit.

adjuster_notes_history.author: System
adjuster_notes_history.note: Claim denied - driving under the influence exclusion applies.

adjuster_notes_history.author: T. Naidoo
adjuster_notes_history.note: Large tree fell on roof during storm, impact damage to structure. Standard building cover, no endorsements.

adjuster_notes_history.author: System
adjuster_notes_history.note: Settled: R140,000 (claimed R150,000 less R10,000 standard excess).
